Trusted Types

The plugin renders through a Trusted Types policy, so template markup survives require-trusted-types-for 'script' instead of throwing on every mount.

Served with a Content-Security-Policy header by the spec, because a document-level policy cannot be set from the page itself. Open this page by hand and no policy applies, which is why the spec asserts the enforcement separately. The rest of the plugin is covered on index.html.

Render and project under an enforced policy

The card is cloned from a template and the actions slot is filled, both of which write markup that the policy would otherwise refuse.
